q.q: Which gate outputs 1 only when the two inputs are different?
q.x: XOR (exclusive OR) outputs 1 when inputs differ and 0 when they are equal. It is the basic gate used for bit comparison.

q.q: In Boolean algebra, what is the value of X + X' (X OR NOT X)?
q.x: The complement law states X + X' = 1 (either X or its complement is always true). Similarly X · X' = 0.

q.q: Which gate is the complement (NOT) of the AND gate?
q.x: NAND = NOT AND. It outputs 0 only when all inputs are 1; otherwise it outputs 1.
